The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

Regarding the effectiveness of the encryption methods mentioned in the paragraph: The text describes the implementation of AES-256 bit encryption. AES-256 is currently considered highly effective and secure. It uses a 256-bit key, resulting in 2^256 possible keys, which makes brute-force attacks computationally infeasible with current technology. It is widely accepted by security experts and government agencies (including the NSA for top-secret information) as a robust standard for protecting sensitive data. Therefore, the assessment in the paragraph that it is "very secure" and "nearly impervious to brute-force attacks" is accurate.
